chunks: Yunus ibn Ya'qub asked Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a cow offered as a sacrifice, and he said:

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abū ʿAbdillāh, Imam Jaʿfar al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.يُضَحَّى: is offered as a sacrificial animal
key_terms.يُونُسُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ: Yunus ibn Ya'qub, the narrator who asked the Imam

ai.seo_question: How many people can share in sacrificing one cow according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding sacrificial offerings, stating that one cow is sufficient on behalf of seven people. It is significant in fiqh because it clarifies the share and validity of participation in a single sacrificial animal.
